text:
Iron is extracted from hematite. Aluminium is extracted from bauxite.
Which statements about the extraction processes are correct?
1
Both involve reduction.
2
Both take place at high temperature.
3
Both involve electrolysis.
A
1, 2 and 3
B
1 and 2 only
C
1 and 3 only
D
2 and 3 only
subject: Chemistry
